abstract: The authors report on three infants who had an unusual variant of sacrococcygeal teratoma--a highly vascularized tumor. All three patients had major problems perioperatively, which resulted in cardiac arrest in all three and the death of one. Several suggestions are made concerning diagnosis as well as preoperative and intraoperative management of this rare tumor variant.
abstract_ja: 我々は、仙尾部奇形腫の非定型的な変異型である高度に血管の豊富な腫瘍を示した3例の乳児について報告する。3例とも周術期に重大な問題が生じ、いずれも心停止に至り、1例が死亡した。この希少な腫瘍変異型の診断、ならびに術前および術中管理について、いくつかの提案を行う。
